# pub title
title: "From Board to Screen and Back: Exploring Continuous Transmedial Play"

# publication image
image:
  name: boardtoscreen.png
  alt-text: "It shows a picture of the board game Tidal Blades 2 and a digital app that extends the game. Between them, there's an arrow that shows the elements that transition from the board game to the digital app, including resources, the characters, and the cards." # provide a short description for the image #a11y

# short description of the publication
description: "Hybrid games combine physical and digital play, but often relegate one medium to a mandatory supporting role. We present a transmedial approach in which players engage in separate physical and digital play sessions while maintaining continuity across them. To explore this, we designed a game prototype extending an existing board game into digital sessions and conducted a user study with 16 participants. Our findings show how continuity across mediums is supported by carefully linking narrative and mechanics, enabling flexible progression, and balancing individual and group progression to sustain engagement."
